name: Dried buffalo
summary: Thịt trâu khô is dried buffalo. Bao Son La’s 27 January 2023 night-market article names it with hearth sausage, eaten with a cup of strong wine. It is not the hearth-smoked buffalo and not the Ban Ang smoked meat. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Moc Chau night market. Bao Son La, 27 January 2023.
howToEat: Eat it at the night market with hearth sausage and a cup of strong wine. The article does not name the still.
Weekends are the fuller trading days. A clock and the price are Check on arrival.
where: The food side of the night market, a ground of more than 2 ha around the Pha Luong light park, in the guesthouse quarter of the old farm town. Nearly 60 stalls. No stall is a pick.
seoTitle: Dried buffalo at the Moc Chau night market
seoDescription: Thịt trâu khô is dried buffalo at the Moc Chau night market, with hearth sausage. A clock was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
